### CVE-2004-0173
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2004-09-01 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 23751: Apache Cygwin 1.3.x/2.0.x - Directory Traversal (remote/windows, 2004-02-24, verified=1)

Directory traversal vulnerability in Apache 1.3.29 and earlier, and Apache 2.0.48 and earlier, when running on Cygwin, allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via a URL containing "..%5C" (dot dot encoded backslash) sequences.

### CVE-2004-0490
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2004-06-03 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 24141: cPanel 5 < 9 - Local Privilege Escalation (local/linux, 2004-05-24, verified=1)

cPanel, when compiling Apache 1.3.29 and PHP with the mod_phpsuexec option, does not set the --enable-discard-path option, which causes php to use the SCRIPT_FILENAME variable to find and execute a script instead of the PATH_TRANSLATED variable, which allows local users to execute arbitrary PHP code as other users via a URL that references the attacker's script after the user's script, which executes the attacker's script with the user's privileges, a different vulnerability than CVE-2004-0529.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

References:
- http://www.securityfocus.com/bid/10407 [vdb-entry,x_refsource_BID]
- https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/16239 [vdb-entry,x_refsource_XF]
- http://bugzilla.cpanel.net/show_bug.cgi?id=664 [x_refsource_CONFIRM]

### CVE-2004-0493
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2004-06-30 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 371: Apache - Arbitrary Long HTTP Headers Denial of Service (dos/linux, 2004-08-02, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 360: Apache - Arbitrary Long HTTP Headers (Denial of Service) (dos/multiple, 2004-07-22, verified=1)

The ap_get_mime_headers_core function in Apache httpd 2.0.49 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion), and possibly an integer signedness error leading to a heap-based buffer overflow on 64 bit systems, via long header lines with large numbers of space or tab characters.

### CVE-2004-1405
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2005-02-12 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 24994: MediaWiki 1.3.x - Arbitrary Script Upload (webapps/php, 2004-12-16, verified=1)

MediaWiki 1.3.8 and earlier, when used with Apache mod_mime, does not properly handle files with two file extensions, such as .php.rar, which allows remote attackers to upload and execute arbitrary code.
